caption: Branch your master resume and measure relevance against real postings. JobRez maintains one master resume, where branches are copies tailored per role, and each branch is scored against the posting in Job DNA. Role match is deterministic using a curated technology taxonomy with aliases, whole-word matching, required terms weighted double and preferred terms once, without cloud AI or external verification. Build your branched resume at https://jobrez.com.
